responsibility: Defines regression tests for the edit-distance utilities in this module, validating Unicode-aware distance computation, limit-based early rejection, substring-aware similarity scoring, best-name suggestion selection over interned symbols, and the specific restricted Damerau-Levenshtein behavior the module exposes.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is the only one focused on fuzzy-name matching utilities, covering edit-distance calculations and best-match selection for symbols. Unlike the other same-named files, it tests suggestion algorithms rather than source locations, file text analysis, or symbol interner identity semantics.
